title: Restroom Redoubt
description: Simulate robots on a toroidal grid and find the Easter egg pattern.
writeup:
## Approach

Robots move with constant velocity on a grid that wraps around (toroidal). Each position after `t` steps is `(x + vx*t) % width, (y + vy*t) % height`.

## Part 1

After 100 steps, count robots in each quadrant (excluding the middle lines) and multiply the four counts.

## Part 2

Find the time step where robots form a Christmas tree. The trick is that the tree frame has robots clustered together, which minimises the safety score (quadrant product). Since the grid is 101×103, positions repeat with period `101*103 = 10403`, so checking all steps in that range is sufficient. The minimum safety score corresponds to the Easter egg.
